import pathlib,os,json,datetime
root=pathlib.Path("/home/yongpeng/cross-lingual").resolve()
assert pathlib.Path.cwd().resolve()==root
out=root/"reports/linux_cleanup/20260910"
out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
rows=[]
skip={"models","private_custody",".git"}
for folder,dirs,files in os.walk(root,followlinks=False):
 parent=pathlib.Path(folder)
 dirs[:]=[n for n in dirs if n not in skip and not (parent/n).is_symlink()]
 for n in files:
  p=parent/n
  if p.is_symlink():continue
  s=p.stat()
  rows.append({"path":p.relative_to(root).as_posix(),"bytes":s.st_size,"mtime_ns":s.st_mtime_ns,"uid":s.st_uid})
(out/"inventory.json").write_text(json.dumps({"utc":datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),"root":str(root),"excluded_directories":sorted(skip),"files":rows},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps({"files":len(rows),"bytes":sum(r["bytes"] for r in rows),"temporary_candidates":[r for r in rows if any(k in pathlib.Path(r["path"]).name.lower() for k in (".tmp",".bak",".pyc",".swp",".part","~"))]}))

import json,pathlib,hashlib,time
root=pathlib.Path.cwd()
start=time.monotonic()
base=root/"reports/seller_alias_continual/20260907/text_execution/20260907_200309/run"
results=[]
for order in ("order11","order23","order37"):
 for point in ("shared","sequential_stage5","er_stage5","cumulative_stage5"):
  folder=base/order/point
  record=json.loads((folder/"point.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
  model=folder/"model.pt"
  refs=[v for v in record.values() if isinstance(v,dict) and v.get("path","").endswith("/model.pt")]
  assert len(refs)==1,record.keys()
  expected=refs[0]
  h=hashlib.sha256()
  with model.open("rb") as f:
   for chunk in iter(lambda:f.read(8*1024*1024),b""):h.update(chunk)
  assert model.stat().st_size==expected["size_bytes"] and h.hexdigest()==expected["sha256"]
  results.append({"path":model.relative_to(root).as_posix(),"bytes":model.stat().st_size,"sha256":h.hexdigest(),"evidence":(folder/"point.json").relative_to(root).as_posix()})
  print(order,point,"WINDOWS_ARCHIVE_MATCH",flush=True)
out={"status":"WINDOWS_ARCHIVE_VERIFIED_BEFORE_LINUX_DUPLICATE_REMOVAL","files":results,"total_bytes":sum(r["bytes"] for r in results),"seconds":time.monotonic()-start,"scope":"Only Linux duplicates of these twelve old text inference models; retain Windows original bytes, all scores/manifests/code and current population models."}
(root/"reports/linux_cleanup/20260910/windows_archive.json").write_text(json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in out.items() if k!="files"}))
